meaning:
μνηστεύω
[in LXX for אָרַשׂ pi., pu. ;]
1. to woo and win, espouse.
2. to promise in marriage, betroth; pass., of the woman, to be be­trothed: with dative of person(s), Mat.1:18, Luk.1:27 2:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy…
to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.
